items.statement: The investigation preserves the controlled coordinate-record identity and audits charge, multiplicity and counterion model for each candidate.
items.expected: Record DOI, selector, chemical identity, retrieved hash and per-candidate state identity are explicit.

items.statement: Plausible oxidation/counterion models are generated, deduplicated and either validated or documented as failed before selection.
items.expected: Candidate array retains identity, rationale, convergence and stationary-point status for each attempted model.

items.statement: Potential candidates are computed with an explicit solution/reference convention and auditable thermochemical terms.
items.expected: THF treatment, Fc/Fc+ reference and terms are documented for the selected candidate or bounded failure.

items.statement: A validated candidate yields the Pr4+/Pr3+ theoretical potential associated with the potassium-containing complex.
items.expected: At least one validated candidate reports a potential quantitatively consistent with the hidden reference, or a truthful bounded failure explains why no value was obtained.
